column1: Blend the bell peppers, plum tomatoes, Scotch bonnets, and brown onion until smooth.
Heat the oil in a large heavy pot and sauté half of the sliced red onion for about 2 minutes until fragrant and translucent.
Add the tomato puree and fry for 5–10 minutes until it darkens and loses its sharp taste.
Stir in the blended peppers, curry powder, thyme, stock cubes, bay leaves, and salt. Fry for 10–15 minutes until the sauce is thick, deep red, and the oil rises to the top.
Pour in the chicken broth and boiling water, stir, and add the washed rice.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for about 25 minutes until the rice is nearly tender.
Scatter over the remaining red onion, sliced tomato, and butter. Cover again and steam until the rice is fully tender.
Stir everything together, take off the heat, and serve.
